#### Which programs are deep learning?

Which of these programs are deep learning (@def-deep-learning)?

- A spam filter whose rules a person wrote.
- The classifier of @exr-two-features-ten-digits, on center ink and left ink.
- The same classifier on the two PCA [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature) of @exm-representation-learning.
- AlexNet (@exm-deep-learning).

:::
